en: This room gives off an antique vibe.
...These are Victorian.

These decorations adorned the British Empire
at the peak of Queen Victoria's reign.
This...must be my research lab.

During the Victorian era, employing a maid
was considered a status symbol.

Speaking of the Victorian era...<CLT=cltSTRONG>Jack the Ripper<CLT=cltNORMAL>
was from that time, correct?
...Ever the detective, I see.

<CLT=cltMIND>So, this is the <CLT=cltSTRONG>Ultimate Maid<CLT=cltMIND>'s lab...
It does seem to be perfectly suited for Kirumi.

Hm...Victorian.
This room is quite tasteful.

Kehehe... I don't dislike Gothic styles 
such as this.
Ah, yeah...me too.

This appears to be Kirumi's research lab.
Being in here brings a tale to my mind...

<CLT=cltMIND>Korekiyo closed his eyes and spoke
as if in a trance...
The era is 19th century England...

A gentleman who pledged his loyalty to the
Queen and a modest, but beautiful maid...

The story of a love that blooms between 
the light and darkness of social classes...

...That sounds like the plot
of a manga for girls.

Is that so? Then, are you saying I am
like some young, lovestruck girl?

Kehehe... So that is how I am reflected 
in your eyes. Fascinating...

<CLT=cltMIND>...I have no idea what
that's supposed to mean.

This room is nice. I am quite fond of it.
Sister would like it too...

In the Victorian era, many servants lived beneath
the manors in which they were employed.

They were known as the "downstairs people,"
as a stark reminder of their lower station.
<CLT=cltMIND>I'll investigate around here a little more.
Yes
No
Are you unsure of something?
<CLT=cltSYSTEM>Would you like to leave?

<CLT=cltMIND>There are a lot of washing machines
in here...

<CLT=cltMIND>These are some powerful cleaning tools. You
could get a lot of cleaning done with these.
<CLT=cltMIND>It's a monitor for communicating with us.

<CLT=cltMIND>It's so clunky...
I wonder if that's just what Monokuma likes.

<CLT=cltMIND>I wonder if there's a bunch of maid uniforms
in this closet...

<CLT=cltMIND>Instead, there were a bunch of laundry
machines, vacuums, and pressure washers.

These appliances will prove most useful when
I perform my cleaning.

Cleaning? You mean, the school?
Kirumi, you don't have to do that...
...I do not mind. To serve others is a maid's duty.

"<CLT=cltSTRONG>Selfless devotion<CLT=cltNORMAL>" is the principle by which
I perform my responsibilities as a maid.

I can cast aside my personal feelings for the sake
of serving <CLT=cltSTRONG>everyone<CLT=cltNORMAL>.

I suppose that's what makes you the
<CLT=cltSTRONG>Ultimate Maid<CLT=cltNORMAL>. Most people wouldn't do that.

Please let me know if you have a request. Given
our situation, I will not take monetary payment.
I will do anything you ask.

<CLT=cltMIND>Anything...?
It's kind of intimidating if you say it like that...

<CLT=cltMIND>This closet has vacuum cleaners
and a high-powered pressure washer.

<CLT=cltMIND>You could get a lot of
cleaning done with these...

<CLT=cltMIND>There's a doll at the dining table...
Perhaps a family dinner?

This is my research lab... Then I presume these
figures represent those I must serve.
<CLT=cltMIND>I'll investigate around here a little more.
